notes: UK-market model from Viscount Classical Organs (Bicester) on Viscount's Physis platform. The MIDI scheme is taken from Viscount's Physis reference manual and assumed to apply; check on your organ.
Stop names are the English specification. The organ also has Baroque, Romantic and Symphonic styles that rename and revoice the stops.
4 manuals (assumed Choir = Man.I, Great = Man.II, Swell = Man.III, Solo = Man.IV), 32-note pedalboard, Swell, Choir and Solo expression pedals.

Stops transmit Viscount SysEx F0 31 4n xx yy F7 (on) / F0 31 0n xx yy F7 (off), n = section channel, xx yy = internal voice ID. Voice IDs are not published for this model (and change if an alternative voice is selected), so no stop bindings are included: use Learn every stop.

Couplers are only received (F0 31 2F 70 vv F7), not transmitted; tremulant on/off is sent as tremulant speed/depth SysEx (depth 00 = off), which a stop binding cannot express. Learn or set these by hand.
all_stops_off is the documented Viscount Cancel message F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7. Expression pedals send CC11 (0-127) on the section's channel; divisional volumes send CC7 (not mapped).
Check on your organ: the channel numbers are factory defaults and can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu (a dealer may have changed them).
Stop list: https://viscountorgans.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Regent-469-pdf-new-pics.pdf (Viscount Classical Organs UK brochure, English Specification, p. 8)

MIDI scheme: https://www.viscountinstruments.com/img/PhysisEU_ReferenceManual-EN-v117-7.pdf (Physis Organs Reference Manual EU v1.17, sect. 14.6 Detailed MIDI implementation, pp. 115-118: 4-manual defaults Man.IV=ch1, Man.III=ch2, Man.II=ch3, Man.I=ch4, Pedal=ch5, ch16 system)
